activities.title: Carbon in daily objects
activities.summary: List items used since morning; sort into metal, glass/clay, carbon-compound columns.

activities.title: Homologous series of alcohols
activities.summary: Compare formulae and masses of CH₃OH, C₂H₅OH, C₃H₇OH, C₄H₉OH; identify homologous pattern.

activities.title: Models of carbon compounds
activities.summary: Use molecular model kits to build methane, ethane, ethene, ethyne structures.

activities.title: Burning carbon compounds
activities.summary: Burn small samples; test flame and residue; relate to saturated/unsaturated nature.

activities.title: Bromine water test
activities.summary: Add bromine water to hydrocarbon samples; note decolourisation with unsaturated compounds.

activities.title: Functional group identification
activities.summary: Build and name alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids from model kits.

activities.title: Esterification
activities.summary: Warm ethanol and acetic acid with conc. H₂SO₄; smell fruity ester formed.

activities.title: Saponification
activities.summary: Heat vegetable oil with NaOH; add salt to precipitate soap.

activities.title: Hydrogenation of oil
activities.summary: Discuss nickel-catalysed addition of H₂ to vegetable oil forming vanaspati ghee.

activities.title: Ethanol reactions
activities.summary: Study reactions of ethanol — combustion, oxidation to ethanoic acid, esterification.

activities.title: Soap vs detergent in hard water
activities.summary: Shake soap and detergent solutions separately in hard water; compare foam and scum.

activities.title: Micelle demonstration
activities.summary: Discuss how soap forms micelles around oily dirt in water.

exercise_mcqs.question: Ethane, with the molecular formula C₂H₆ has
exercise_mcqs.explanation: C₂H₆ has 1 C–C + 6 C–H = 7 single covalent bonds.

exercise_mcqs.question: Butanone is a four-carbon compound with the functional group
exercise_mcqs.explanation: Butanone (CH₃COC₂H₅) contains the ketone (–CO–) functional group.

exercise_mcqs.question: While cooking, if the bottom of the vessel is getting blackened on the outside, it means that
options: the food is not cooked completely
the fuel is not burning completely
exercise_mcqs.explanation: Black soot from incomplete combustion deposits on the vessel bottom.

intext_samples.question: Carbon compounds are generally poor conductors because they have
intext_samples.explanation: Carbon compounds form covalent bonds — no free ions/electrons in solid state.

intext_samples.question: Carbon forms a large number of compounds mainly due to
intext_samples.explanation: Catenation (self-linking) and tetravalency give carbon its versatility.

intext_samples.question: The general formula of alkanes is
intext_samples.explanation: Alkanes are saturated with formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂.

intext_samples.question: Bromine water decolourises when added to
intext_samples.explanation: Ethene (unsaturated) undergoes addition with bromine; alkanes do not decolourise bromine water.

intext_samples.question: On adding alkaline KMnO₄ to ethanol and warming, ethanol is oxidised to
intext_samples.explanation: Alkaline KMnO₄ oxidises ethanol (primary alcohol) to ethanoic acid.

intext_samples.question: Soap does not work well in hard water because it forms
intext_samples.explanation: Soap reacts with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ in hard water forming insoluble scum.
